system.description:
This spell causes an area of water to be reduced to half its normal depth. If cast on part of a larger body of water, it will create a trench in the water's surface and will hold back the sides for the duration.

Any boat or ship caught in such a trench will take 1d12+20 points of hull damage when the water rushes back at the end of the duration, and all items on deck (including people if they fail spell save) will be swept off the ship.
